# Data Source: tfe_hyok_encrypted_data_key

This data source can be used to retrieve a Hold Your Own Keys (HYOK) encrypted data key.

## Example Usage

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        new DataTfeHyokEncryptedDataKey.DataTfeHyokEncryptedDataKey(this, "tfe_hyok_encrypted_data_key1", new DataTfeHyokEncryptedDataKeyConfig {
            Id = "dek-123"
        });
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `Id` (String) The ID of the HYOK encrypted data key.

### Read-Only

- `CreatedAt` (String) The timestamp when the key version was created.
- `CustomerKeyName` (String) The customer provided name of the HYOK encrypted data key.
- `EncryptedDek` (String) The encrypted data encryption key (DEK) of the HYOK encrypted data key.
